title: A Spanish-First Website for RIOwell
description: Turned a new wellness club's public Instagram material into a bilingual website concept with one clear path to WhatsApp.
seoDescription: How I researched, designed, and built a responsive Spanish-first website concept for a neighborhood recovery and wellness club in Buenos Aires.
constraints: This was a self-initiated cold-pitch prototype based on public source material rather than a client brief, brand kit, analytics, or private operating information.
The source material lived across a new Instagram account, including posts, highlights, and a narrated facility walk-through.
The public source material included no prices or class schedules, so the site explains the offer and routes those questions to WhatsApp.
The available social photography needed a more intentional editorial image system to carry a premium website.
problem: RIOwell was preparing to open a recovery and wellness club in Núñez with an Instagram presence but no website.
Its story was spread across 50 public images and videos, captions, highlight slides, and a 100-second founder walk-through instead of one clear customer journey.
The concept needed to explain movement, recovery, memberships, and the neighborhood location in Spanish while giving interested visitors one obvious next step.
solution: Captured and organized the public source material into a verified inventory, then used the real service catalog, brand language, and facility details to shape the site's information architecture.
Designed a Spanish-first, bilingual single-page experience around three ideas: move, recover, and belong.
Built the responsive site in Astro with restrained GSAP motion, a full-screen mobile menu, contextual WhatsApp actions, and a lazy-loaded Google Maps embed.
result: Shipped a public Cloudflare Pages preview with complete Spanish and English routes and a responsive experience across desktop and mobile.
Turned scattered social content into a clear story that helps visitors understand the club before they ask about availability or pricing on WhatsApp.
deliveryHighlights: Researched and cataloged 50 public media files, including posts, highlights, captions, comments, and a founder-led facility walk-through.
Shipped Spanish and English routes from one shared Astro component and typed copy layer.
Built a responsive navigation system with a full-screen mobile menu and an icon-only mobile WhatsApp action.
Added a lazy-loaded Google Maps embed and reduced repeated calls to action to a smaller set of deliberate conversion points.
Verified both routes with production builds, browser checks, console review, responsive testing, and an accessibility pass.
